name: Oathkeeper's Vow
body:
Drawbacks
Oathkeeper's Vow
Source Divine Anthology pg. 18
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Kols
The clergy of Kols trained you to make unbreakable vows. You add the following spells to the paladin spell list at the indicated levels: command (1st), forbid actionAPG (1st), suggestion (to fulfill a prior promise only; 2nd), lesser geas (3rd), geas/quest (4th).
